political_background.summary: Nand Kishor Ram contested the Bihar Assembly elections from the Ramnagar (SC) constituency as an RJD candidate in 2015 and 2020, losing on both occasions.
Sanjay Kumar Pandey is an MLA from Narkatiaganj constituency in Bihar, having won the 2020 assembly elections on a BJP ticket. He previously contested and lost from the same constituency in 2015.
